subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the sentence is describing the unique feature of **the tuatara, particularly its third eye.**
 
• **"Intriguing"** is the appropriate adjective that captures the curiosity and interest in such a rare feature.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Absorbing – Incorrect, as "absorbing" implies something that fully engages one's attention, which doesn’t fit as well as "intriguing" in this context.
 
• **Option 2:** Escalating – Incorrect, as "escalating" refers to something increasing rapidly, which is not relevant to describing a feature.
 
• **Option 4:** Diverting – Incorrect, as "diverting" implies shifting attention away from something, which does not accurately describe the unique characteristic of the tuatara.
